grades.quote: When MODE=Direct, all traps into supervisor mode cause the `pc` to be set to the address in the BASE field. When MODE=Vectored, all synchronous exceptions into supervisor mode cause the `pc` to be set to the address in the BASE field, whereas interrupts cause the `pc` to be set to the address in the BASE field plus four times the interrupt cause number.
grades.reason: Directly explains stvec MODE field: Direct sets pc to BASE for all traps; Vectored sets pc to BASE for synchronous exceptions and BASE+4×cause for interrupts, with example and alignment note.
